reviews.author: Renzo
reviews.body:
I had the most incredible facial with Celida, who immediately made me feel completely relaxed and pampered the moment I walked in. Even though the extractions were a bit discomfortable, her gentle reassurance and comforting technique made the entire process so much easier to handle. She is incredibly professional and attentive, ensuring I was comfortable every single step of the way. Since my appointment, she has completely transformed my skin, leaving it looking incredibly refreshed, healthy, and absolutely glowing. I cannot recommend Celida enough for anyone looking for both a deeply relaxing experience and real, radiant results!

Much love,

Renzo
